type: CAPABILITY BUILT + ONE MORE SELF-INFLICTED DEFECT
title: 23 of 23 read verbs now return the real command's output on a file they never saw. Two rounds ago it was 1 of 23. Both causes were mine.

the_headline_number.measured: teach all 23 verbs with postcondition=None (the GOAL decides the type), ask on a file with different contents, compare to the real command's output

progression.before r45: 1/23 correct (only 'unique lines', by luck of shape)

the_headline_number.what_changed: nothing about the learner. The learner never failed. The system was answering a question nobody asked, and calling a legitimate empty result a crash.

defect_one_the_teacher_chose_the_type.finding: Every skill in the track was taught with postcondition={'kind':'stdout_line_count'}, so all 23 answered 'how many lines did the program print'.
defect_one_the_teacher_chose_the_type.note: this was MY harness choice in r41, not a property of the engine. The engine accepted any contract; I passed the same one 23 times.
defect_one_the_teacher_chose_the_type.fix: postcondition is now optional. postcondition=None calls infer_contract_from_goal(goal): 'how many'/'count' -> integer, 'sha256'/'md5'/'checksum' -> first token, listing phrasings -> lines, otherwise lines. Simple and literal by design; named as a heuristic, not comprehension.

defect_two_no_match_was_a_crash.finding: `grep PATTERN f` exits 1 when nothing matches. The carrier treated ANY non-zero exit as a failed step, so an empty answer became FAIL_CLOSED and a grep skill could not even be taught on a file with no matches.
defect_two_no_match_was_a_crash.fix: exit_one_means_empty(program, code): only for grep/egrep/fgrep/uniq/diff/cmp, only exit code 1. The step is still ok=False and is reported as EMPTY_RESULT -- explicitly NOT success, so an empty answer and a breakage stay distinguishable in the receipt.
defect_two_no_match_was_a_crash.external_confirmation: This is the field's problem too, on this exact date: a NousResearch/hermes-agent issue opened 2026-11-09 reports that grep/diff exit 1 classified as informational are still reported as failures to post-tool-call observers. A second 2026 thread documents null collapsing 'no results' and 'tool didn't run' into one indistinguishable signal. The distinction I added is the one the ecosystem is still getting wrong.

the_sharper_warning_from_that_same_readi: The other 2026 thread is about agents that APPEAR to succeed -- a tool returned null, the agent read it as 'no results found', and confidently reported that a whole field of research does not exist. My fix makes empty answers first-class, which makes that failure MORE reachable, not less. So the next requirement is not another verb: it is that a typed answer is never allowed to stand as a factual claim without a source.

REAL: 23/23 read verbs return the real command output on unseen files with different contents (measured r46).
The goal now determines the answer type: hash, integer, lines, text.
A legitimate empty result is a first-class answer ([]), distinct from a breakage, with the distinction surviving into the receipt.
Safety unchanged and re-verified: writers refused, shell refused, pipe smuggling refused, live tree untouched.
Everything from r41-r45 still stands: permanence 23/23, composition 3/4, environment shift 23/23 in three of five, typed answers.
NOT_REAL: That this is general learning. It is 23 single-step read verbs on a shell. The learner still maps one anchored sentence to one argv.
That the reliability arithmetic moved: 318-step tasks at 99% per step remain 4.09%; Opus 5.5 needs 99.774% per step for 48.7%.
That a path containing a space works (r45, still unfixed).
That anything touches a public benchmark: still ZERO public-benchmark numbers.
That 'shape is not truth' is solved. A well-typed 64-char hash is still just a string.

the_sentience_claim: Unchanged, and now easier to state precisely. Twenty-three verbs returning their own program's output is a correct lookup table -- better than what I had two rounds ago and still a table. Nothing here has a model of itself, a goal of its own, a preference, or a representation of the environment beyond a bound parameter. Every improvement this project has made is a software-engineering improvement to a table.

the_smartest_things_to_do_next.1: Never let a typed answer stand as a factual claim without a source. 23/23 correct on the shell is exactly the condition under which an empty answer starts to look like a finding. Attach the argv, the file, and the exit semantics to every answer.
the_smartest_things_to_do_next.2: Propagate empty_result through the pipe layer as well as the single-command layer (done here for stage N, but a mid-pipe no-match is still a hard stop).
the_smartest_things_to_do_next.3: Fix the space-in-path two-parameter bug (r45) before it is baked into more skills.
the_smartest_things_to_do_next.4: Still no write access. 23/23 reads is the first time the read path is trustworthy; writes should not arrive until the empty-vs-failure distinction has been exercised outside a test.

changed: causal_trace_to_skill_compiler_v1.py -- infer_contract_from_goal, optional postcondition, empty_result accepted as a completed step
admitted_confinement_execution_v1.py -- exit_one_means_empty, EMPTY_RESULT status in both single-command and pipe paths
artifacts.r41_track: unchanged 23/33 (it still passes its own postcondition explicitly)
